node: Student-loan servicing, education payments, and compliance infrastructure
summary: Expanded the universe around the regulated operating layer behind student finance: servicing systems, payment collection, tuition/payment workflows, private-loan ownership/servicing, and compliance-heavy borrower infrastructure. The strongest underfollowed mapping is Nelnet because its public filings explicitly split Loan Servicing and Systems from Education Technology Services and Payments. Flywire is a cleaner education-payments software/rails candidate. SLM is an obvious private-student-loan reference name rather than hidden infrastructure. Navient remains relevant as a policy/compliance case study and legacy education-loan asset owner/master servicer, but its direct servicing exposure appears diminished after outsourcing to MOHELA, so it is included as a speculative-shadow candidate rather than a clean chokepoint beneficiary.
